correctness.rationale: For any current unit modal coin vectors, first/second conditional moments follow exactly from scalar/traceless Haar conjugation covariance and the commutant projector of dimension d²−1. Iterating from Z_0=1 yields E Z_t=λ^t and E|Z_t|²=1/d+(1−1/d)γ^t. A literal two-by-two partial trace gives both purities. The boundary |λ|=1 and negative γ are handled. Coin dimension d≥2, all t≥0; no statistical experiment is needed for proof.

originality.rationale: The new statement is an exact expectation of a nonlinear single-realization two-mode purity and its finite-time/limiting separation from purity after averaging. Quillen calculates the averaged first-moment quantum channel but not this two-copy recurrence; existing walk-entanglement studies use other noise and initial-state conditions. Generic Haar covariance identities are recognized as standard tools, so novelty pertains to this walk-specific closed law. Actual published-finding corpus and primary literature searches found no statement or stronger theorem covering all the claimed parameters; priority is not certified globally.
residual_risks: Generic common-noise fidelity Markov recursions in literature outside this bounded coverage might imply the theorem, even though no equivalent under the same walk setting was located.
Some adjacent disorder papers were assessed from selected sections/abstract rather than independently reproducing every appendix or result; this does not serve as global priority certification.
